ideas.title: International cooperation key to solving Minnesota fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the role of international cooperation in solving the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
ideas.angle: How international cooperation led to the arrest of Abdikerm Eidleh
questions: What role did international cooperation play in the arrest?
How can international cooperation be improved to prevent similar fraud schemes?
ideas.insight: The arrest of Abdikerm Eidleh in Somalia highlights the importance of international cooperation in solving large-scale fraud schemes.
